rule: Per map chunk, a 3D density noise sets how many dungeons there are; a per-chunk style stream rolls room count, room sizes, a large-room chance, a diagonal flag and hole width. A dungeon is a walker: the first room is placed, then for each further room the walker finds a door site on a wall, optionally carves a door, walks a corridor of random length with segments, turns and optional stairs, and places a new box room so its door lines up with the corridor end. Rooms are boxes whose interior is protected from later carving. Biomes are the nearest point in heat and humidity space, scaled by weight and limited to a box, with a dithered vertical blend. Schematics place cells with a per-cell probability and overwrite only air unless forced.
keep: room-and-walk grammar: door site on a wall, door coin flip, corridor walk with segments and turns, room placed so its door lines up with the corridor end
blocked step turns the walker and still spends its length budget
room interior protected from later carving (untouchable flag)
per-chunk style roll from its own salted stream so new rolls do not shift old ones
biome as nearest point in climate space with weight, box limit and dithered vertical blend
structure as cells with per-cell probability and force flag; overwrite only air unless forced
change: diagonal door direction leaves the room position unset (only axis directions assign it): handle or reject diagonal doors
dungeon that cannot place its next door stops silently with a partial result: report failed zone and retry with next seed
range calls throw at runtime for sizes below 4: validate ranges when a zone row loads
stored schematic probability of 1 never places a cell (roll is 1 to 127, skip when stored is at most roll): fix the off-by-one
schematic rolls and rotation use the process-wide generator seeded from OS randomness: draw from the zone's seeded stream
mapgen v6 block seed is a linear sum with no mixing: use the mixed hash only
look_test: Render six zones from one room-and-walk row with six seeds, top-down at 375 px wide. Dom ranks: reads as rooms and corridors, looks like noise, looks cut off. Then one camp schematic with the current probability rule and with the fix (one cell at 1); Dom says whether the fixed version shows the cell.
